title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 27
paragraphs: Of these, the Lemnians fought well, and after defending themselves a long time were at last brought down. Over the survivors the Persians set as governor Lycaretus, the brother of that Maeandrius who had been king of Samos. This Lycaretus ruled in Lemnos until his death. And the cause of it was this: he went on enslaving and subjugating everyone, accusing some of having gone over to the Scythians and others of damaging Darius's army as it was coming back from Scythia.
